review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Poppy asks everyone how they feel, and why: worried or excited, proud or embarrassed, bored, fed up or homesick, and what you look forward to and what you miss.
description.sl: Poppy vsakogar vpraša, kako se počuti in zakaj: zaskrbljen ali navdušen, ponosen ali osramočen, zdolgočasen, naveličan ali domotožen ter česa se veseliš in kaj pogrešaš.
description.it: Poppy chiede a tutti come si sentono e perché: preoccupati o emozionati, orgogliosi o imbarazzati, annoiati, stufi o con la nostalgia di casa, e che cosa aspettano con gioia e che cosa manca loro.
description.de: Poppy fragt alle, wie sie sich fühlen und warum: besorgt oder aufgeregt, stolz oder verlegen, gelangweilt, genervt oder voller Heimweh, worauf man sich freut und was man vermisst.

words.example_en: Maggie is worried because Jack isn't back from the fell yet.
words.example_sl: Maggie je zaskrbljena, ker Jacka še ni nazaj s hriba.
words.example_it: Maggie è preoccupata perché Jack non è ancora tornato dal monte.
words.example_de: Maggie ist besorgt, weil Jack noch nicht vom Berg zurück ist.
words.note: Worried about something: Don't worry about it!
words.note_sl: Worried about something: Don't worry about it! (Ne skrbi!)
words.note_it: Worried about something: Don't worry about it! (Non preoccuparti!)
words.note_de: Worried about something: Don't worry about it! (Mach dir keine Sorgen!)

words.example_en: Harry is nervous before his first swimming race.
words.example_sl: Harry je pred prvo plavalno tekmo živčen.
words.example_it: Harry è nervoso prima della sua prima gara di nuoto.
words.example_de: Harry ist vor seinem ersten Schwimmrennen nervös.
words.note: Nervous is afraid of what will happen, not angry.
words.note_sl: Nervous pomeni tesnoben pred nečim, ne jezen.
words.note_it: Nervous vuol dire in ansia per qualcosa, non arrabbiato.
words.note_de: Nervous heißt unruhig vor etwas, nicht gereizt.

words.example_en: The children are so excited about Bonfire Night.
words.example_sl: Otroci se tako veselijo kresne noči.
words.example_it: I bambini sono così emozionati per la Bonfire Night.
words.example_de: Die Kinder sind so aufgeregt wegen der Bonfire Night.
words.note: Excited is a happy feeling. Exciting is what makes you excited: an exciting day.
words.note_sl: Excited je vesel občutek. Exciting je tisto, kar te navduši: an exciting day.
words.note_it: Excited è un'emozione felice. Exciting è ciò che emoziona: an exciting day.
words.note_de: Excited ist ein frohes Gefühl. Exciting ist, was einen so macht: an exciting day.

words.example_en: Jack was disappointed when his ram came second at the show.
words.example_sl: Jack je bil razočaran, ko je bil njegov oven na razstavi drugi.
words.example_it: Jack è rimasto deluso quando il suo montone è arrivato secondo alla fiera.
words.example_de: Jack war enttäuscht, als sein Widder auf der Schau Zweiter wurde.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson is proud of his grandson's drawing.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson je ponosen na vnukovo risbo.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson è orgoglioso del disegno di suo nipote.
words.example_de: Mr Tyson ist stolz auf die Zeichnung seines Enkels.
words.note_sl: Proud of something: s predlogom of.

words.example_en: I was so embarrassed when I called Mrs Hartley "Mum".
words.example_sl: Bil sem v taki zadregi, ko sem gospe Hartley rekel »mama«.
words.example_it: Ero così imbarazzato quando ho chiamato la signora Hartley «mamma».
words.example_de: Es war mir so peinlich, als ich Mrs Hartley »Mama« genannt habe.
words.note: Embarrassed is how you feel; embarrassing is what makes you feel it: an embarrassing mistake.
words.note_sl: Embarrassed je, kako se počutiš; embarrassing je tisto, kar te spravi v zadrego: an embarrassing mistake.
words.note_it: Embarrassed è come ti senti; embarrassing è ciò che imbarazza: an embarrassing mistake.
words.note_de: Embarrassed ist, wie man sich fühlt; embarrassing ist, was peinlich ist: an embarrassing mistake.

words.example_en: Alfie is jealous of the new lamb, because everyone wants to stroke it.
words.example_sl: Alfie je ljubosumen na novo jagnje, ker ga vsi hočejo pobožati.
words.example_it: Alfie è geloso del nuovo agnellino, perché tutti vogliono accarezzarlo.
words.example_de: Alfie ist eifersüchtig auf das neue Lamm, weil alle es streicheln wollen.

words.example_en: Old Wilf was lonely after his wife died, until he started telling stories.
words.example_sl: Stari Wilf je bil po ženini smrti osamljen, dokler ni začel pripovedovati zgodb.
words.example_it: Il vecchio Wilf si sentiva solo dopo la morte della moglie, finché non ha cominciato a raccontare storie.
words.example_de: Der alte Wilf war nach dem Tod seiner Frau einsam, bis er anfing, Geschichten zu erzählen.
words.note: Lonely is sad because you are alone; alone is just without other people.
words.note_sl: Lonely je žalosten, ker si sam; alone pomeni le brez drugih.
words.note_it: Lonely è triste perché solo; alone vuol dire soltanto senza altri.
words.note_de: Lonely ist traurig allein; alone heißt nur ohne andere.

words.example_en: We were all relieved when the rescue team found the walkers.
words.example_sl: Vsem se je odvalil kamen od srca, ko je reševalna ekipa našla pohodnike.
words.example_it: Eravamo tutti sollevati quando la squadra di soccorso ha trovato gli escursionisti.
words.example_de: Wir waren alle erleichtert, als die Bergrettung die Wanderer gefunden hat.

words.example_en: Poppy was upset because someone broke her sandcastle.
words.example_sl: Poppy je bila prizadeta, ker ji je nekdo podrl peščeni grad.
words.example_it: Poppy era turbata perché qualcuno le aveva rotto il castello di sabbia.
words.example_de: Poppy war ganz aufgebracht, weil jemand ihre Sandburg kaputt gemacht hat.
words.note: Upset is sad and hurt, often with a few tears; an upset stomach is a bad stomach.
words.note_sl: Upset je žalosten in prizadet, pogosto s solzami; an upset stomach je pokvarjen želodec.
words.note_it: Upset è triste e ferito, spesso con qualche lacrima; an upset stomach è il mal di pancia.
words.note_de: Upset ist traurig und gekränkt; an upset stomach ist ein verdorbener Magen.

words.example_en: I'm very grateful for all your help with the move.
words.example_sl: Zelo sem hvaležen za vso pomoč pri selitvi.
words.example_it: Ti sono molto grato per tutto l'aiuto con il trasloco.
words.example_de: Ich bin dir sehr dankbar für deine Hilfe beim Umzug.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson gets annoyed when walkers leave the gate open.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson postane razdražen, ko pohodniki pustijo vrata odprta.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson si secca quando gli escursionisti lasciano il cancello aperto.
words.example_de: Mr Tyson ist genervt, wenn Wanderer das Gatter offen lassen.

words.example_en: On rainy days the children get bored indoors.
words.example_sl: Ob deževnih dneh se otroci v hiši dolgočasijo.
words.example_it: Nei giorni di pioggia i bambini si annoiano in casa.
words.example_de: An Regentagen langweilen sich die Kinder drinnen.
words.note: Bored is how you feel; boring is what makes you feel it: a boring film.
words.note_sl: Bored je, kako se počutiš; boring je tisto, kar je dolgočasno: a boring film.
words.note_it: Bored è come ti senti; boring è ciò che annoia: a boring film.
words.note_de: Bored ist, wie man sich fühlt; boring ist, was langweilt: a boring film.

words.example_en: Alfie is scared of the dark, so he sleeps with a torch.
words.example_sl: Alfie se boji teme, zato spi s svetilko.
words.example_it: Alfie ha paura del buio, così dorme con una torcia.
words.example_de: Alfie hat Angst im Dunkeln, darum schläft er mit einer Taschenlampe.
words.note: Scared of something: of. It is a little less formal than afraid.
words.note_sl: Scared of something: s predlogom of. Je nekoliko manj formalno kot afraid.
words.note_it: Scared of something: con of. È un po' meno formale di afraid.
words.note_de: Scared of something: mit of. Etwas weniger förmlich als afraid.

words.example_en: Arthur stays calm, even when the bees are angry.
words.example_sl: Arthur ostane miren, tudi ko so čebele jezne.
words.example_it: Arthur resta calmo anche quando le api sono arrabbiate.
words.example_de: Arthur bleibt ruhig, auch wenn die Bienen wütend sind.
words.note: Say calm "kahm": the l is silent.
words.note_sl: Calm se izgovori "kahm": l se ne sliši.
words.note_it: Calm si pronuncia "kahm": la l non si sente.
words.note_de: Calm spricht man "kahm": das l ist stumm.

words.example_en: I'm so glad you came to the fête!
words.example_sl: Tako sem vesel, da si prišel na vaški sejem!
words.example_it: Sono così contento che tu sia venuto alla festa!
words.example_de: Ich bin so froh, dass du zum Dorffest gekommen bist!

words.example_en: The new bus timetable has left everyone confused.
words.example_sl: Novi vozni red avtobusov je vse zmedel.
words.example_it: Il nuovo orario degli autobus ha confuso tutti.
words.example_de: Der neue Busfahrplan hat alle verwirrt.

words.example_en: Edna was surprised to see snow in April.
words.example_sl: Edna je bila presenečena, ko je aprila zagledala sneg.
words.example_it: Edna è rimasta sorpresa di vedere la neve ad aprile.
words.example_de: Edna war überrascht, im April Schnee zu sehen.

words.example_en: I'm fed up with this rain, it hasn't stopped for a week!
words.example_sl: Sit sem tega dežja, že teden dni ne neha!
words.example_it: Sono stufo di questa pioggia, non smette da una settimana!
words.example_de: Ich habe die Nase voll von diesem Regen, er hört seit einer Woche nicht auf!
words.note: Fed up with something: with. Very British and very common.
words.note_sl: Fed up with something: s predlogom with. Zelo britansko in pogosto.
words.note_it: Fed up with something: con with. Molto britannico e comune.
words.note_de: Fed up with something: mit with. Sehr britisch und häufig.

words.example_en: In her first week at the inn, the new waitress was homesick.
words.example_sl: Nova natakarica je prvi teden v gostilni imela domotožje.
words.example_it: La prima settimana alla locanda la nuova cameriera aveva nostalgia di casa.
words.example_de: In ihrer ersten Woche im Gasthaus hatte die neue Kellnerin Heimweh.

words.example_en: Sam is always in a good mood, even on Monday mornings.
words.example_sl: Sam je vedno dobre volje, tudi ob ponedeljkih zjutraj.
words.example_it: Sam è sempre di buon umore, anche il lunedì mattina.
words.example_de: Sam ist immer gut gelaunt, sogar am Montagmorgen.

words.example_en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, let's go to the inn.
words.example_sl: Nocoj nimam volje kuhati, pojdimo v gostilno.
words.example_it: Stasera non ho voglia di cucinare, andiamo alla locanda.
words.example_de: Ich habe heute keine Lust zu kochen, gehen wir ins Gasthaus.
words.note: Feel like + -ing or a noun: I feel like a cup of tea.
words.note_sl: Feel like + -ing ali samostalnik: I feel like a cup of tea.
words.note_it: Feel like + -ing o un nome: I feel like a cup of tea.
words.note_de: Feel like + -ing oder ein Nomen: I feel like a cup of tea.

words.example_en: We're looking forward to the summer holidays.
words.example_sl: Veselimo se poletnih počitnic.
words.example_it: Non vediamo l'ora delle vacanze estive.
words.example_de: Wir freuen uns auf die Sommerferien.
words.note: After look forward to comes a noun or -ing: I look forward to seeing you.
words.note_sl: Za look forward to pride samostalnik ali -ing: I look forward to seeing you.
words.note_it: Dopo look forward to va un nome o -ing: I look forward to seeing you.
words.note_de: Nach look forward to kommt ein Nomen oder -ing: I look forward to seeing you.

words.example_en: Edna misses her sister when Maggie goes to Kendal.
words.example_sl: Edna pogreša sestro, ko gre Maggie v Kendal.
words.example_it: A Edna manca la sorella quando Maggie va a Kendal.
words.example_de: Edna vermisst ihre Schwester, wenn Maggie nach Kendal fährt.
words.note: Miss also means not to catch: I missed the bus.
words.note_sl: Miss pomeni tudi zamuditi: I missed the bus.
words.note_it: Miss vuol dire anche perdere: I missed the bus.
words.note_de: Miss heißt auch verpassen: I missed the bus.
